categories.main_business_segments: Dayu Irrigation Group primarily operates in the digital water conservancy industry, focusing on agricultural water-saving irrigation, rural water infrastructure, water resources management, and ecological environment services. The company is organized into four main business groups: Dayu Agricultural Water Group (engineering and infrastructure construction), Dayu Design Group (water conservancy planning and consulting), Dayu Huitu Group (digital twin modeling, software and hardware development, information integration), and Dayu Equipment Development Group (smart irrigation equipment manufacturing and sales). Their services cover the entire water use chain from water source to farmland, including water conservancy design, water resource scheduling, water environment governance, and rural sewage treatment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company integrates modern technologies such as IoT, cloud computing, remote sensing, blockchain, big data, digital twin, and AI with traditional water conservancy. It develops smart hardware like intelligent metering and control gates, smart water meters, soil moisture sensors, and high-efficiency irrigation products including drip irrigation tapes and intelligent water-fertilizer integration machines. They also innovate in ecological environmental equipment and regional sonic rain enhancement technology. Their production follows an order-driven, sales-forecast combined model with centralized procurement and flexible factory deployment. R&D focuses on digital twin platforms, smart irrigation control, and water resource optimization models.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's key customers are government entities at various levels, central and local water conservancy departments, agricultural and rural development agencies, and large state-owned enterprises. They serve industries including agriculture, water conservancy, rural infrastructure, and ecological environment management. The company also extends services internationally to over 60 countries, including projects in Vietnam, Uzbekistan, Cuba, Nigeria, South Africa, Thailand, Pakistan, Russia, and Croatia. Their markets cover modern irrigation, rural water supply, flood control, and digital water management solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: Dayu Irrigation has a nationwide presence across China, covering all provincial-level regions except Shanghai and Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan. The company has significant market penetration in Northwest, North China, East China, Central China, and Southwest China regions, with rapid growth in Southwest China. Internationally, it operates in over 60 countries, with active projects and partnerships in Central Asia, Africa, Southeast Asia, and Eastern Europe. The company also has manufacturing and R&D bases in Tianjin and other strategic locations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Dayu Irrigation operates across the entire supply chain of digital water conservancy, including upstream R&D and manufacturing of smart irrigation equipment, midstream engineering design and construction, and downstream operation and maintenance services. It provides integrated solutions from planning, design, equipment production, project delivery to long-term operation and digital management, positioning itself as a full-cycle service provider and a core supplier in the water-saving and digital water management ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in digital water conservancy technologies, focusing on digital twin modeling, AI-driven water resource scheduling, smart irrigation control, and ecological environment equipment. It invests heavily in R&D with a team of about 600 IT professionals and multiple national and provincial research platforms. Key R&D projects include urban-rural integrated water supply systems, modern irrigation cloud platforms, intelligent water-fertilizer integration, and sonic rain enhancement devices. The company also pursues strategic alliances with universities and international partners to advance technology and expand application scenarios.
categories.revenue_model: Dayu Irrigation generates revenue primarily through product sales of smart irrigation and water management equipment, engineering construction contracts (EPC and EPC+O models), design and consulting services, software and system integration services, and long-term operation and maintenance contracts. The company uses a direct sales model supported by a nationwide marketing network and also engages in government and social capital cooperation projects under concession and BOT models. Revenue streams include hardware sales, software licensing, service fees, and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Dayu Irrigation is a leading and influential enterprise in China's digital water conservancy sector, recognized as a pioneer in integrating social capital into farmland water conservancy reforms. It holds a top market share among private enterprises and is a key player in setting industry technical standards. The company competes with large state-owned enterprises and other private firms but differentiates itself through comprehensive full-chain solutions, advanced digital technologies, and extensive nationwide and international presence. It maintains strategic partnerships with major central enterprises, enhancing its competitive positioning.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Dayu Irrigation achieved operating revenue of approximately 4.38 billion RMB, representing a 26.83% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about 81.13 million RMB, up 61.81%. The company’s total assets reached around 9.35 billion RMB, growing 17.53% from the previous year. Operating cash flow turned positive with a net inflow of nearly 597 million RMB, a significant improvement. The company maintains steady growth driven by strong order intake (over 5.3 billion RMB in new contracts) and expanding market coverage.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Dayu Irrigation emphasizes its comprehensive digital water conservancy ecosystem, integrating advanced digital twin technology, AI, and IoT with traditional water management. Its unique value lies in providing full lifecycle, customized, and integrated solutions covering planning, design, manufacturing, construction, and operation. The company’s smart equipment, such as intelligent metering and sonic rain enhancement devices, offer high efficiency, precision, and environmental benefits. Its innovative business models linking government, social capital, and farmers balance risks and benefits, ensuring sustainable project operation and superior service quality.
